```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Implementation of the 2D annotation enrichment method from Cox & Mann
# 2012, BMC Bioinformatics (doi: 10.1186/1471-2105-13-S16-S12). For each
# annotation term (GO term or TF target gene set), tests whether member
# genes show a significantly different joint distribution in PC1 x PC2
# space compared to all other genes, using MANOVA on per-dimension
# ranked data (a non-parametric generalisation of the Wilcoxon test to
# 2D). Effect size is an (s.PC1, s.PC2) score pair, each bounded [-1, 1].
# FDR controlled by Benjamini-Hochberg.

# Paths relative to this Rmd's location (Adriana_analysis/scripts/)
project_dir <- ".."
load(file.path(project_dir, "project_functions.rda"))

paths       <- setup_project_paths(project_dir)
tables_dir  <- paths$tables_dir
figures_dir <- paths$figures_dir
output_dir  <- paths$output_dir
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(org.Sc.sgd.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(GO.db)

select <- dplyr::select

# Shared colour palette for dissertation figures
load(file.path(project_dir, "project_colours.rda"))
```

```{r load-pca}
# PC1/PC2 gene scores, the only meaningful axes (PC4+ is noise)
pca_genes <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "PCA_genes_AC.txt"),
                      show_col_types = FALSE)

all_genes <- pca_genes$gene_id
n_genes   <- length(all_genes)

# Rank each PC dimension separately across all genes, per Cox & Mann:
# "the data is replaced by ranks in each dimension separately"
pca_ranked <- pca_genes %>%
  select(gene_id, PC1, PC2) %>%
  mutate(
    rank_PC1 = rank(PC1, ties.method = "average"),
    rank_PC2 = rank(PC2, ties.method = "average")
  )

cat("Genes loaded:", n_genes, "\n")
cat("PC1 rank range:", range(pca_ranked$rank_PC1), "\n")
cat("PC2 rank range:", range(pca_ranked$rank_PC2), "\n")
```

```{r cox-mann-function}
# Core 2D annotation enrichment function, implementing Cox & Mann 2012:
# split genes into group 1 (annotation term members) and group 2 (all
# remaining genes), apply MANOVA to the pre-ranked PC1/PC2 values,
# extract a p-value from the MANOVA Pillai test statistic, and calculate
# s-scores as s = 2 * (mean_rank_group1 - mean_rank_group2) / n, bounded
# [-1, 1] with positive meaning enriched at high PC score.
run_2d_enrichment_single <- function(gene_set, ranked_df, min_size = 5) {
  # filter gene set to genes present in PCA data
  members <- intersect(gene_set, ranked_df$gene_id)
  n1 <- length(members)

  if (n1 < min_size) return(NULL)

  n2 <- nrow(ranked_df) - n1
  if (n2 < 1) return(NULL)

  # split into group 1 (members) and group 2 (rest)
  df_g1 <- ranked_df %>% filter(gene_id %in% members)
  df_g2 <- ranked_df %>% filter(!gene_id %in% members)

  # MANOVA on ranked data (the Cox & Mann non-parametric 2D test)
  combined <- bind_rows(
    df_g1 %>% mutate(group = 1L),
    df_g2 %>% mutate(group = 2L)
  )

  fit <- tryCatch(
    summary(manova(cbind(rank_PC1, rank_PC2) ~ factor(group),
                   data = combined),
            test = "Pillai"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

  p_value <- fit$stats["factor(group)", "Pr(>F)"]

  # s-scores: 2*(mean_rank_g1 - mean_rank_g2) / n_total, per Cox & Mann
  n_total <- nrow(ranked_df)
  s_pc1 <- 2 * (mean(df_g1$rank_PC1) - mean(df_g2$rank_PC1)) / n_total
  s_pc2 <- 2 * (mean(df_g1$rank_PC2) - mean(df_g2$rank_PC2)) / n_total

  tibble(
    n_members    = n1,
    p_value      = p_value,
    s.PC1        = s_pc1,
    s.PC2        = s_pc2
  )
}

# Wrapper to run across a named list of gene sets and apply BH FDR
run_2d_enrichment <- function(genesets, ranked_df, min_size = 5, label = "") {
  cat("Running 2D enrichment:", label, "-", length(genesets), "gene sets\n")

  results <- map(names(genesets), function(set_name) {
    res <- run_2d_enrichment_single(genesets[[set_name]], ranked_df, min_size)
    if (!is.null(res)) res %>% mutate(set = set_name)
    else NULL
  }) %>%
    compact() %>%
    bind_rows()

  if (nrow(results) == 0) {
    cat("  No results returned\n")
    return(results)
  }

  # Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across all tested sets
  results <- results %>%
    mutate(p.adjust = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    select(set, n_members, p_value, p.adjust, s.PC1, s.PC2)

  n_sig <- sum(results$p.adjust < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(" ", nrow(results), "sets tested |", n_sig, "significant (FDR < 0.05)\n")
  results
}
```

```{r build-go-genesets}
# Build GO gene sets from org.Sc.sgd.db + GO.db, same approach as
# script 04 to keep annotation consistent
cat("Building GO gene sets from org.Sc.sgd.db...\n")

build_go_genesets <- function(ontology) {
  go_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Sc.sgd.db,
    keys    = keys(org.Sc.sgd.db, keytype = "ORF"),
    columns = c("GO", "ONTOLOGY"),
    keytype = "ORF"
  ) %>%
    filter(ONTOLOGY == ontology, !is.na(GO)) %>%
    dplyr::select(ORF, GO)

  go_terms <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    GO.db,
    keys    = unique(go_map$GO),
    columns = "TERM",
    keytype = "GOID"
  ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(GO = GOID)

  go_map %>%
    left_join(go_terms, by = "GO") %>%
    mutate(label = if_else(!is.na(TERM),
                           paste0(TERM, " (", GO, ")"), GO)) %>%
    group_by(label) %>%
    summarise(genes = list(unique(ORF)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    deframe()
}

go_genesets <- c(
  build_go_genesets("BP"),
  build_go_genesets("MF"),
  build_go_genesets("CC")
)
cat("GO gene sets built:", length(go_genesets), "\n")
```

```{r build-tf-genesets}
# TF gene sets from Mahendrawada et al. 2025, Tables A (binding), C
# (activation/repression), E (direct) - same construction as script 05
supp_path <- file.path(tables_dir, "Supp Table 3 updated.xlsx")
table_a   <- read_excel(supp_path, sheet = "Table-S3a")
table_c   <- read_excel(supp_path, sheet = "Table-S3c")
table_e   <- read_excel(supp_path, sheet = "Table-S3e")

# Table A: binding gene sets
tf_cols_a   <- colnames(table_a)[-1]
genesets_tf_a <- map(tf_cols_a, ~table_a %>% filter(.data[[.x]] == 1) %>% pull(gene_id)) %>%
  set_names(paste0(tf_cols_a, "_bound")) %>%
  keep(~length(.x) >= 5)

# Table C: activated (log2FC < 0) and repressed (log2FC > 0)
tf_cols_c     <- setdiff(colnames(table_c), c("gene_id", "Kmeans_clusters"))
table_c_long  <- table_c %>%
  select(gene_id, all_of(tf_cols_c)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "TF", values_to = "log2FC") %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FC))

genesets_tf_c <- bind_rows(
  table_c_long %>% filter(log2FC < 0) %>%
    group_by(TF) %>% summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(TF = paste0(TF, "_activated")),
  table_c_long %>% filter(log2FC > 0) %>%
    group_by(TF) %>% summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(TF = paste0(TF, "_repressed"))
) %>%
  filter(map_int(genes, length) >= 5) %>%
  deframe()

# Table E: direct targets
tf_cols_e    <- colnames(table_e)[-1]
table_e_long <- table_e %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_id, names_to = "TF", values_to = "log2FC") %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FC))

genesets_tf_e <- bind_rows(
  table_e_long %>% filter(log2FC < 0) %>%
    group_by(TF) %>% summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(TF = paste0(TF, "_direct_activated")),
  table_e_long %>% filter(log2FC > 0) %>%
    group_by(TF) %>% summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_id)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(TF = paste0(TF, "_direct_repressed"))
) %>%
  filter(map_int(genes, length) >= 5) %>%
  deframe()

cat("TF gene sets - Table A:", length(genesets_tf_a),
    "| Table C:", length(genesets_tf_c),
    "| Table E:", length(genesets_tf_e), "\n")
```

```{r run-enrichment}
# Run 2D enrichment across GO and TF gene sets
results_go <- run_2d_enrichment(go_genesets,    pca_ranked, label = "GO terms")
results_tf_a <- run_2d_enrichment(genesets_tf_a, pca_ranked, label = "TF binding (Table A)")
results_tf_c <- run_2d_enrichment(genesets_tf_c, pca_ranked, label = "TF act/rep (Table C)")
results_tf_e <- run_2d_enrichment(genesets_tf_e, pca_ranked, label = "TF direct (Table E)")
```

```{r plot-function}
# 2D scatter plot of (s.PC1, s.PC2) for significant terms, matching Cox
# & Mann Figure 4 layout. Colour = significance; quadrant labels added.
if (!requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("ggrepel")
library(ggrepel)

plot_2d_enrichment <- function(results, title, fdr_cutoff = 0.05,
                                n_label = 12) {
  sig <- results %>% filter(p.adjust < fdr_cutoff)

  if (nrow(sig) == 0) {
    cat("No significant results for:", title, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # label most extreme terms per quadrant
  df_label <- sig %>%
    mutate(
      dist = sqrt(s.PC1^2 + s.PC2^2),
      quadrant = case_when(
        s.PC1 >= 0 & s.PC2 >= 0 ~ "Q1",
        s.PC1 <  0 & s.PC2 >= 0 ~ "Q2",
        s.PC1 <  0 & s.PC2 <  0 ~ "Q3",
        s.PC1 >= 0 & s.PC2 <  0 ~ "Q4"
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(quadrant) %>%
    slice_max(dist, n = ceiling(n_label / 4)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(label = truncate_label(set, width = 40))

  ggplot(sig, aes(x = s.PC1, y = s.PC2)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = -log10(p.adjust)), alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = project_colours["grey"]) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = project_colours["grey"]) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = df_label,
      aes(label = label),
      size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 20
    ) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = project_colours["white"], high = project_colours["red"]) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf,  y = Inf,  label = "high PC1\nhigh PC2",
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 2.8, color = "grey40") +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,  label = "low PC1\nhigh PC2",
             hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 2.8, color = "grey40") +
    annotate("text", x = Inf,  y = -Inf, label = "high PC1\nlow PC2",
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5, size = 2.8, color = "grey40") +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = -Inf, label = "low PC1\nlow PC2",
             hjust = -0.1, vjust = -0.5, size = 2.8, color = "grey40") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      subtitle = paste0(nrow(sig), " significant terms (FDR < ",
                        fdr_cutoff, ") from ", nrow(results), " tested"),
      x = "Effect size PC1 (s.PC1)",
      y = "Effect size PC2 (s.PC2)",
      color = expression(-log[10]("adj. p-value"))
    ) +
    theme_bw()
}
```

```{r plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=9}
plot_2d_enrichment(results_go,   "2D annotation enrichment - GO terms (Cox & Mann 2012)")
plot_2d_enrichment(results_tf_a, "2D annotation enrichment - TF binding / Table A (Cox & Mann 2012)")
plot_2d_enrichment(results_tf_c, "2D annotation enrichment - TF act/rep / Table C (Cox & Mann 2012)")
plot_2d_enrichment(results_tf_e, "2D annotation enrichment - TF direct targets / Table E (Cox & Mann 2012)")
```

```{r save-outputs}
write_tsv(results_go,   file.path(output_dir, "2d_enrichment_go.txt"))
write_tsv(results_tf_a, file.path(output_dir, "2d_enrichment_tf_tableA.txt"))
write_tsv(results_tf_c, file.path(output_dir, "2d_enrichment_tf_tableC.txt"))
write_tsv(results_tf_e, file.path(output_dir, "2d_enrichment_tf_tableE.txt"))

plots <- list(
  go   = plot_2d_enrichment(results_go,   "2D enrichment - GO terms"),
  tf_a = plot_2d_enrichment(results_tf_a, "2D enrichment - TF binding (Table A)"),
  tf_c = plot_2d_enrichment(results_tf_c, "2D enrichment - TF act/rep (Table C)"),
  tf_e = plot_2d_enrichment(results_tf_e, "2D enrichment - TF direct (Table E)")
)

for (nm in names(plots)) {
  if (!is.null(plots[[nm]])) {
    ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, paste0("2d_enrichment_", nm, ".png")),
           plot = plots[[nm]], width = 10, height = 9)
  }
}

cat("Done - results saved to output_tables/ and figures/\n")
```
